name: OpenProject
tagline: Project management for whole organisations, from Gantt charts to sprints
description: A web-based project management suite: work packages with configurable types and workflows, Gantt charts, agile boards and backlogs, time and cost tracking, meetings and a wiki. It is built for organisations that plan in both classic and agile styles.
licenseNote: The Community edition is GPL-3.0 and covers the core planning features. Some features, including single sign-on over OpenID Connect and SAML and the more advanced boards, are Enterprise add-ons that need a paid plan, self-hosted or in the cloud. Check the current list before relying on a feature.
backing: OpenProject GmbH (Germany), funded by Enterprise subscriptions and its hosted service

maturity.rationale: More than a decade of regular releases from a stable company, with wide use in public administration, universities and industry. Upgrades are well documented.

selfHosting.summary: Official Docker images and Linux packages, with PostgreSQL included or external. Installing is straightforward; the time goes on outgoing mail, backups, and setting up types, workflows and roles to match how the organisation works.

requirements.notes: More for a few hundred active users.

managedHosting.label: OpenProject Cloud
managedHosting.note: Run by the developers and hosted in the EU; paid per user

strengths: Covers classic and agile planning in one place: Gantt charts, backlogs, boards, time and cost tracking
Types, workflows, roles and custom fields can be shaped to an organisation's process
A stable company and release rhythm, with a hosted option in the EU
weaknesses: Open core: single sign-on and the more advanced boards need a paid plan
Heavier and more formal than a team that just wants a board will enjoy
No one-step import from Jira or Asana that carries everything

featureNotes.kanban: Basic boards are free; boards driven by status or assignee are an Enterprise add-on
featureNotes.jira-import: OpenProject has been building Jira migration tooling; what it covers today was not checked
featureNotes.mobile-apps: The web interface works on phones; the state of the official app was not checked
featureNotes.free-sso: OpenID Connect and SAML are Enterprise add-ons; LDAP sign-in is free
